open_points.subject: A6 rule 5 enforcement for a damaged mark without a placement
open_points.text: a damaged mark without a placement stops a new placement
open_points.question: Which module must detect the damaged mark during a delivery with no placement, and through which delivery_store capability, given that delivery_store owns INV-20 while photo_delivery declares knowledge of only rule 4 of A6?
options: photo_delivery must know A6 rule 5 and call read_mark before creating a placement
read_placement must also inspect the corresponding mark and refuse when it is damaged
delivery_store must expose a combined placement-and-mark state read used by photo_delivery
open_points.default_guess: Add a combined placement-and-mark state read owned by delivery_store, and have photo_delivery use it under the project lock.

witness.initial: A project has no placement record for a source id, but its corresponding mark file exists and is damaged.
events: The caller asks photo_delivery to deliver a valid source with that source id.
One implementer has photo_delivery call read_placement and then read_mark; another makes a delivery_store placement-state read validate both records.
outcomes: photo_delivery directly depends on and sequences both record reads under A6 rule 5
delivery_store encapsulates the cross-record validity rule and photo_delivery sees only one state result
witness.observer: A maintainer replacing or testing delivery_store, and the dependency projector, sees different module knowledge and import surfaces.

open_points.subject: retry after a failed placement-record write when a damaged mark exists
open_points.text: After condition 5 a stored image may remain without a record: no caller has received its reference, and a repeated delivery of the same file writes it again and completes the placement.
open_points.question: Must this completion guarantee be qualified so that a damaged mark without a placement instead causes the STATE_UNAVAILABLE refusal required by INV-20, or does the retry guarantee take precedence?
options: Qualify A3 rule 5: the retry completes only if no whole-operation refusal, including a damaged mark, applies
Let A3 rule 5 complete the placement despite the damaged mark
Define an explicit precedence rule between the A3 retry and A6 damaged-state refusal
open_points.default_guess: Qualify A3 rule 5; A6 rule 5 takes precedence and the retry returns M08 without changing the image or records.

witness.initial: A previous placement attempt wrote the stored image but failed to write its placement record; a damaged mark file now exists for the same project and source id.
events: The caller repeats delivery of the same valid source.
The service acquires the project lock and encounters the orphaned image, absent placement record and damaged mark record.
outcomes: A3 rule 5 says the retry writes again and completes the placement.
The changed INV-20 test says the damaged mark stops the new placement, while A6 rule 5 requires an M08 STATE_UNAVAILABLE refusal and no state change.
witness.observer: The caller sees placed or replayed placement data in one implementation and an M08 refusal in the other; the durable placement state also differs.
